original_goal: Build a To-Do app using Flask with SQLite and HTML frontend

plan.description: A simple To-Do app that allows users to create, update, and delete tasks

steps.title: Create Project Structure and Requirements File
steps.description: Set up the project directory, create a requirements.txt file to manage dependencies.

steps.title: Create Database Model
steps.description: Define the database schema and create a Task model using SQLAlchemy.

steps.title: Create Flask App and Routes
steps.description: Define the Flask app, create routes for tasks CRUD operations.

steps.title: Create HTML Templates
steps.description: Design and create HTML templates for the To-Do app UI.

steps.title: Write Tests
steps.description: Write unit tests for the Task model and routes using Pytest or Unittest.

steps.title: Document README
steps.description: Write a brief description of the To-Do app, its features, and usage instructions.
